references.text: The Lord promised to exalt Joshua in the eyes of Israel, and here this promise is fulfilled.
Israel feared the Lord and believed in Moses after the miracles at the Red Sea, just as they now honor Joshua.
Moses was commanded to give Joshua some of his authority so that Israel would obey him.
Joshua was filled with the spirit of wisdom after Moses laid hands on him, and Israel obeyed him.
The people feared the Lord and Samuel, just as they had feared the Lord and Moses, and later Joshua.
The Lord promised to be with Joshua just as he had been with Moses.
